name: Advanced Tactical Academy: Hold the Junction

lessons.title: Hold the Junction
lessons.text: Capture the central junctions instead of chasing kills.

lessons.title: Movement plan
lessons.text: Send units toward the marked objective hexes. Check each objective's control radius.

lessons.title: Fire plan
lessons.text: Protect units holding the objectives. Fire support is valuable even when it does not score directly.

lessons.title: Review the tradeoffs
lessons.text: The turn limit matters: use the mission scoreboard to choose between attacking and holding.

lessons.title: Review
lessons.text: Review the battle record and retry to improve your practice.

mission.name: Hold the Junction
mission.summary: Control the marked junctions at the end of each turn.
